Q5786.reason: Avoidable-consequences limits the estate to the original wound and pain up to the religious refusal; that later choice cuts off liability for the death treatment would have prevented.

Q5253.reason: A reversion is what stays with the transferor by operation of law when less than the whole estate is conveyed, and unlike the other listed future interests it is not subject to the Rule Against Perpetuities.

Q5347.reason: The first 1–2 seconds of a maximal contraction use ATP already stored in the muscle, before phosphocreatine or glycolysis can regenerate it.
